analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($125.35) vs SMA5/20/50 ($123.72/$126.60/$136.41): Trading sideways, above short-term SMA5 but below mid-term SMA20.
· Significant distance below SMA100/200 ($137.75/$153.17): Maintaining strong mid-to-long term downtrend.

· RSI trajectory (38.7→47.2) + Attempting to exit oversold territory, preparing to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2677→0.5133) + Improving, suggesting potential for a bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near mid-band $126.60) + Bandwidth at 22.22%, indicating a period of reduced volatility.

· Swing support ($122.76) + Based on Pivot S1 ($106.88) and SMA200 ($153.17).
· Swing resistance ($146.94) + Requires confirmation of resistance at 50-day moving average ($136.41) if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Potential for a recovery signal, with 5-day low at 114.91 vs 20-day low at 109.21.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.70x) + Reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Consider buying upon confirmation of support at $122.76 and breakout above resistance at $126.60.
